en: Krishna said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadiness in the path of knowledge, giving, self-control, sacrifice, study of scripture, self-discipline and honesty;
non-violence, truth, freedom from anger, letting go, peace, not speaking ill of others, kindness to all beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty and steadiness;
vigour, forgiveness, firmness, purity, no ill will and no excess pride: these belong to one born with the divine nature, Bharata.
Pretence, arrogance, conceit, anger, harshness and ignorance belong to one born with the demonic nature, Partha.
The divine nature leads to freedom; the demonic nature leads to bondage. Do not grieve, son of Pandu: you are born with the divine nature.

first: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
en: There are two kinds of beings in this world, the divine and the demonic. The divine has been described at length; now hear from me about the demonic, Partha.

first: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
en: Demonic people do not know what to do and what to avoid. There is no purity in them, no good conduct and no truth.
They say the world has no truth, no foundation and no God; that it came about from no order but from union, caused by desire and nothing else.
Holding this view, these lost souls of small understanding, doing cruel deeds, rise up as enemies of the world to destroy it.
Clinging to desire that can never be filled, full of pretence, pride and arrogance, holding wrong ideas out of confusion, they act with unclean aims.
Gripped by endless worry that lasts until death, holding the enjoyment of desires as the highest aim, they are sure that this is all there is.
Bound by hundreds of ropes of hope, given over to desire and anger, they try to pile up wealth by unfair means to enjoy their desires.
'This I have gained today; this wish I will fulfil. This wealth is mine, and more will be mine too.'
'I have killed that enemy, and I will kill others too. I am the master, I enjoy, I am successful, strong and happy.'
'I am rich and of high birth. Who else is like me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will enjoy.' So they speak, deceived by ignorance.
Confused by many thoughts, caught in a net of delusion, addicted to the enjoyment of desires, they fall into a foul hell.
Self-important, stubborn, full of the pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only, with pretence and without following the proper rules.

first: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः ।
en: Given over to ego, force, arrogance, desire and anger, these jealous people hate me, who live in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.
These hateful, cruel and impure people, the lowest of humans, I throw again and again into demonic wombs in the cycles of birth.
Entering demonic wombs, these confused people, birth after birth, never reach me, Kaunteya, and so they sink to the lowest state.
Desire, anger and greed: these are the three gates of hell that ruin the self. So one should give up these three.
A person freed from these three gates of darkness, Kaunteya, does what is good for the self and so reaches the highest goal.
Whoever sets aside the rules of scripture and acts on the impulse of desire gains neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.
So let scripture be your guide in deciding what should and should not be done. Knowing what the rules of scripture say, you should do your work here.
